what: Proposed row `breadcrumbs / replace breadcrumb-streaming` is parsed as slug+file-extension `/`+mode+sanitizer; no directory-batch semantics exist
scenario_or_breakage: Awk requires NF==4; `larch_log_batch_extension` returns `/`; `larch_log_batch_path` builds a single replace artifact `…/breadcrumbs/` not a directory tree
